statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ), 1 < n → (∑ a ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n, ∑ u ∈ (Finset.Ico 1 n).filter (fun u => (a*u)%n = 1), w u) = (∑ u ∈ (Finset.Ico 1 n).filter (fun u => u.Coprime n), w u)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Farey 分母对与逆元筛 · HD-8002 · 合并全部逆元窗的任意分母权
plain_statement.en: New route · Farey denominator pairs and inverse sieve · HD-8002 · Recover the unrestricted coprime weight by summing all inverse labels

brief.zh: 交换分母与分子的求和顺序。对每个 u，逆元纤维恰有一项当且仅当 u 与 n 互素。代入真素数对数权，再用 TH-0012 添回对角项。
brief.en: Swap the numerator and denominator sums. Exactly one inverse label contributes when u is a unit. Substitute prime log weights and apply TH-0012 to restore the diagonal term.
